name: What Is Gods Will For My Life
overview: God's will for our lives is revealed through a humble and obedient heart that seeks His guidance and strength. As Psalms 143:10 teaches, we must ask God to lead us in uprightness, while Proverbs 2:1 emphasizes the importance of receiving and treasuring His commandments. Trusting in the Lord as our everlasting strength (Isaiah 26:4) and understanding His plans for peace and hope (Jeremiah 29:11) provide assurance in following His will. Ultimately, Micah 6:8 summarizes God's requirement: to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Him.
